# TPC-DS-OBT Q13

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  AVG(quantity),
  AVG(ext_sales_price),
  AVG(ext_wholesale_cost),
  SUM(ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
WHERE
  (
    store_s_store_sk = store_sk
    AND sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
    AND sold_date_d_year = 2001
    AND (
      (
        ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = ship_cdemo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1'
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1'
        AND sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 3
      )
      OR (
        ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = ship_cdemo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1'
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1'
        AND sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 1
      )
      OR (
        ship_hdemo_sk = bill_hdemo_hd_demo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_demo_sk = ship_cdemo_sk
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_marital_status = '1'
        AND bill_cdemo_cd_education_status = '1'
        AND sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
        AND bill_hdemo_hd_dep_count = 1
      )
    )
    AND (
      (
        ship_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
        AND bill_addr_ca_country = 'United States'
        AND bill_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3')
        AND net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
      )
      OR (
        ship_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
        AND bill_addr_ca_country = 'United States'
        AND bill_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3')
        AND net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
      )
      OR (
        ship_addr_sk = bill_addr_ca_address_sk
        AND bill_addr_ca_country = 'United States'
        AND bill_addr_ca_state IN ('3', '3', '3')
        AND net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
      )
    )
  )
  AND channel = 'store'
```
